gaps.lead: It's pointless to worry about things you can't change.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ things you can't change.

gaps.lead: This is the best coffee I've ever tasted.
gaps.explanation: 'The best I've ever tasted' → 'never tasted better'.

gaps.lead: He had just sat down when the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had + subject + participle … than…

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.

gaps.explanation: last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.
